title: Portrait and Will
author: Xanthe Yarrow
blurb: Rafael Fairweather, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
